text:
maya: Heads-up, opened a small PR to fix a couple of issues in the console quickstart examples: mismatched trace header, stale cost numbers, and a stray yaml flag. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1932

oliver: dropping by to review shortly. can you summarise the concrete user impact?
maya: mainly docs correctness: samples would show `X-Trace-Id` in one place and `x-rd-trace` elsewhere, plus the cost table used an old token accounting method. customers following the example could wire telemetry incorrectly or see confusing cost math.

kevin: quick skimed the diff. node snippet still referenced `response.costTokens` which our SDK removed; suggest `usage.tokens` to match current SDK. also, there's a commented-out kv-prefetch line in the yaml that might confuse readers.
maya: updated node -> `usage.tokens` and removed kv-prefetch from sample. left a note about verifying runtime telemetry mapping for traces.

priya: since this is in quickstart, can we add a compatibility footnote for Dedicated/private customers running older SDKs? one line like: "SDKs <2.3 use legacy telemetry fields; see migration guide."
maya: added the compatibility note with an internal migration link.

oliver: docs-bot CI failure: one broken internal link flagged. docs-bot, paste the CI output.
docs-bot: build check failed: 1 broken link in docs/console/quickstart.md line 140 -> /sdk/telemetry/old (404). Suggested replacement: /sdk/migration/telemetry-2-3.

kevin: i'll open a site-config redirect to avoid future rot. will reference the target migration page.

priya: did the cost numbers change enough to warrant a changelog blurb?
maya: numbers shifted ~6% after accounting for batching defaults. added a short "Docs note" under the quickstart that calls out the update.

oliver: a couple wording nits in the quickstart paragraph, otherwise LGTM. maya, can you squash and i'll merge after standup if CI passes? :white_check_mark:
maya: squashed and pushed fixup. thanks!

kevin: opened site-config PR for redirect: https://github.com/redwood-inference/site-config/pull/217. once that lands old references will 301 to the telemetry migration page.

maya: will merge this after docs CI green and site-config PR is approved. thanks for the quick turnaround all :rocket:
